title: Cache the order list briefly
description: The order page polls GET /api/orders every few seconds, and that is now our busiest route. Its response may be cached for 30 seconds, so the CDN absorbs most of the polling. Includes tests and a README note.

comments.issue: The response is each customer's own order list, but `Cache-Control: public` lets the CDN or any shared cache store it and serve it to other users requesting the same URL, with no `Vary` on the Authorization or Cookie header. Use `private` (or `no-store`) for per-user responses.
